CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions) is explicitly identified and paired with an explicit origin/representation status for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to content presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple entries explicitly identify contents (red/blue) and their positional attributes.

D.rationale: The report separately provides identified content and a distinct origin/status entry for the same content/time.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: Text states how contents are represented/accessed (current vs conditional candidate) and provides origin/representation metadata.
